summary: Iteration 7: Tested Welcome section + newsletter (real Resend email), admin auth/subscribers/CSV, brute-force lockout, Non-Exclusive Lease beat purchase (obsidian-bounce temporarily set live), deterministic ids across restart, and regression (free download, shop, PDP, merch cart, checkout, order success). New suite 14/14 pass. All requested UI flows pass with zero page errors. Home has no 'LUNG PUNCH' or 'Sony' text. Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: Resend blocks @example.com (422 undeliverable_recipient). Signup still saves with welcome_sent=false, which is the expected fallback. Nothing retries a failed welcome email, and the UI still shows 'Welcome in. Check your inbox.' even when welcome_sent is false.

The IP rate limit and lockout key use the first X-Forwarded-For value, which a client can set to anything. An attacker can rotate the header to get past the 5 signups/hour limit and the brute-force lockout.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' is used together with allow_credentials=True. The playbook asks for explicit origins.

Every restart runs delete_many on products and instrumentals, so download counters and any manual edits (for example a coming_soon flag or a real audio_url) are lost. Ids are now stable, but the data is not.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow on mobile (390px): document scrollWidth is 404. The grid has no grid-cols-1 on mobile, so the column takes the content's minimum width.

integration_issues.issue: The page says 'We've sent a confirmation to <email>', but no order email is sent. Payment is a mocked demo.

Lease items show 'Size: Non-Exclusive Lease' in the cart sheet. They also have +/- quantity controls, so a buyer can lease the same beat twice. Consider a 'License:' label and a fixed quantity of 1 for beats.

issues: Perk descriptions start at different x positions (199/209/204px) because the w-36 title span shrinks. Add shrink-0 to keep them aligned.

action_items: Fill /app/memory/test_credentials.md with the admin credentials (the file is currently empty)

Update stale regression tests: test_boombox.py (expects 9 instrumentals and lung-punch-instrumental) and test_dez_store.py (expects 8 products and lung-punch products). 7 tests fail only because the Lung Punch collection was archived.
Optional: show a different toast when welcome_sent is false; set explicit CORS origins; do not trust a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For for rate limiting
Optional: fix mobile horizontal overflow in the Home editorial band; label beats as 'License' in the cart and stop quantity above 1 for leases; reword the order-success 'sent a confirmation' text
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: bcrypt $2b$ hash OK. httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=lax cookie OK. Lockout after 5 tries OK. seed_admin is idempotent (hash unchanged after restart).
server.py: the startup force-reseed wipes downloads and Mongo edits on every restart. Before launch, change it to upsert by slug.
Newsletter duplicate check runs before the rate limit, which is good. The admin subscribers projection excludes _id and ip, which is good.
Order pricing is computed on the server from the DB (the client price is ignored), which is good. Coming-soon and free beats are rejected with 400.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 new). Legacy suites: 26/33, all 7 failures are stale expectations
